checks.name: Upstream manifest surface owns closed judgment production
Builder computes judgments from the exact input sequence once
Manifest contract carries closed judgments as first-class output
Analysis surface projection transports judgments unchanged
Runtime wiring accepts closed judgment, never raw input
Runtime composition contains no semantic authority import or judge call
Adapter is a pure projection and preserves the same judgment/proof
Route analysis looks up the upstream judgment, not an input seed
Package version and build command remain unchanged

architecture.upstream: input seeds -> semantic authority -> closed judgments + derivation evidence
architecture.wiring: manifest/flow projections transport judgments without recomputation

limitations: Static source-contract audit only; TypeScript build and runtime tests must be executed in an environment with dependencies available.
